metadata.title: Social media, content, and email marketing services
metadata.description: Explore monthly social media management, video content, social media audits, TikTok launches, email marketing, and artist projects.

hero.un_serviciu_vedeta_luna_de_luna_plus_cat: One flagship service, month after month, plus a few others for what you need now.

cum_lucram.ne_spui_unde_esti_si_unde_vrei_sa_ajungi: Tell us where you are and where you want to go.
cum_lucram.iti_propunem_ce_are_sens_pentru_tine_cu: We propose what makes sense for you, with clear pricing in writing.
cum_lucram.filmam_scriem_sau_construim_in_functie_d: We film, write, or build, depending on the service. You approve it before we publish.
cum_lucram.masuram_si_iti_spunem_pe_scurt_ce_a_mers: We measure it and briefly explain what worked and what we'll change.

ne_vedem_la_cafea.vorbim_deschis_despre_ce_ai_nevoie_si_ca: Let's talk openly about what you need and what it costs. Seriously, the coffee is on us.
